summary: Only 9 m of island kerb inside the turning circle.
reasons: Stub barely longer than a van
Van would block the turning circle
Houses and building site overlook it

drivers.seclusion: Open turning head with houses and a building site around it; buildings 21 m and more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the central island edge, so a van sits in the turning lane with no room to pull fully clear.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end court, little traffic, but residents and site vehicles must turn here.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the outer kerb, not at the island.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; tree shade from the north-west.
